openwrt_wiki.Modelle: UniFi AC Mesh (indoor/outdoor), aka UAP-AC-M (techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/uap-ac-mesh); UniFi AC Mesh Pro (indoor/outdoor), aka UAP-AC-M-PRO
openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: In 2016 came two similar AC devices under the "Mesh" label. From what is known of the official firmware releases, these devices use the same platform.
openwrt_wiki.5 GHz Wireless Phy: The chip Ubiquiti U-AME-G1-BR4A seems to be a custom labeled QCA9882-BR4A (2x2:2 MIMO). It is detected as QCA988X/hw2.0 and supported by the ath10k driver.
openwrt_wiki.Serial console: The device has two pinheaders with serial ports. Both ports operate at 3.3V level, 115200 Baud, 8N1 and have the pinout +3,3V - RX - TX - GND. The port to the left (shown red) gives access to U-Boot and OpenWrt's console. The purpose of the other port (shown blue) is not identified yet. Using the default/factory U-Boot environment there are no outputs from the kernel during booting. Instead, one has to send a newline at 9600 Baud (to activate the console) and then login at 115200 Baud again. (Foto und Bootlogs: AC Lite)
openwrt_wiki.Installation: Kein factory-Image ("Factory" headers are not necessary ... no "factory" OpenWrt binaries exist); nicht-invasiv per SSH aus der Stock-Firmware mit dd oder mtd (Bootloader ggf. auf 3.7.58 zurueck; Kommentar: "Ubiquiti UniFi AC Mesh downgraded from UAP-AC-Mesh-BZ.6.0.14 also works with OpenWrt 21.02.2", mtd0-md5 d0f1e59ea240c7cfff0d2cecc7481d0a); alternativ serielle Konsole + U-Boot tftpboot. Different builds for the different models (Lite, Mesh, Pro, etc).
openwrt_wiki.Reset beim Einschalten: Reset (am Geraet oder am PoE-Injektor) beim Einschalten: nach ca. 5 s blaue LED, U-Boot loescht cfg; weitere 8 s: Default-U-Boot-Env, TFTP-Server auf 192.168.1.20, LEDs blau/weiss blinkend; nimmt nur Dateien mit Ubiquiti-Firmware-Header (sysupgrade.bin scheitert)
openwrt_wiki.OEM Firmware / TFTP recovery: OpenWrt cannot be flashed this way since the firmware must be signed. Any version of the official firmware should work. Reset gedrueckt halten beim Einstecken, bis LED-Ring weiss/blau/aus blinkt (ca. 15 s), PC statisch 192.168.1.x, tftp PUT BZ.qca956x....bin auf 192.168.1.20. Going back to the original firmware is no problem at all.
openwrt_wiki.LEDs: The UniFi AP AC has two LEDs (ubnt:white:dome, ubnt:blue:dome)
openwrt_wiki.802.11s Mesh: As of OpenWrt 19.07 802.11s meshing is broken on Qualcomm AC Wave1 chipsets (ath10k-ct); normal upstream firmware and kmod (without -ct) must be installed.

openwrt_git_ar71xx.text: This adds the build option for the new UniFi AC Mesh. It is a direct hardware copy from the AC Lite. - SoC: QCA9563-AL3A (775Mhz) - RAM: 128MiB - Flash: 16MiB - dual firmware partitions! - LAN: 1 1000M - POE - Wireless: 2.4G: QCA9563 5G: UniFi Chip, QCA988X compatible. Thanks to Frank Dietz for testing.

openwrt_git_ar71xx_erkennung.titel: ar71xx: add model detection for UBNT AC-Mesh
openwrt_git_ar71xx_erkennung.text: Previously said device was incorrectly detected as UniFi AC-Lite. The Information about the device is stored at 0xC in the EEPROM partition. It corresponds to the sysid in /etc/board.info of the Ubiquiti stock firmware.

openwrt_git_ath79.titel: ath79: add support for Unifi AC Mesh
openwrt_git_ath79.text: The Unifi AC Mesh is equivalent to the Unifi AC Lite. However, for setting certain parameters with the flashed device it is helpful that the devices know their variant (e.g. automatically setting antenna gain for the different antennas in Lite and Mesh).

openwrt_git_firmware_kombiniert.titel: ath79: combine UniFi AC dual firmware-partitions
openwrt_git_firmware_kombiniert.text: In order to maximize the available space on UniFi AC boards using a dual-image partition layout, combine the two OS partitions into a single partition. ... The initial installation has to be done with an older version of OpenWrt in case the generated image exceeds the space of a single kernel partition in the future.

fcc_handbuch.Titel: UniFi AC Mesh Quick Start Guide, "802.11AC Dual-Band Indoor/Outdoor Access Point, Model: UAP-AC-M"
fcc_handbuch.Package Contents: UniFi AC Mesh, Antennas (Qty. 2), Wall Mount Bracket, Screws (Qty. 2), Screw Anchors (Qty. 2), Zip Ties (Qty. 2), Fast-Mount Adapter, Gigabit PoE (24V, 0.5A) with Mount Bracket, Power Cord, Quick Start Guide
fcc_handbuch.Terms of Use: Ubiquiti radio devices must be professionally installed. Shielded Ethernet cable and earth grounding must be used as conditions of product warranty.
fcc_handbuch.Installation Requirements: Wall-mounting: Drill and 6 mm drill bit; Phillips screwdriver; Shielded Category 5 (or above) cabling should be used for all outdoor wired Ethernet connections and should be grounded through the AC ground of the PoE.
fcc_handbuch.Hardware Overview: Front: Status LED; Right Side: Port Cover

LED.Steady White: Factory default, waiting to be integrated.
LED.Alternating White/Blue: Device is busy; do not touch or unplug it (e.g. firmware upgrade).
LED.Steady Blue: integrated into a network and working properly
LED.Steady Blue with occasional flashing: isolated state (all WLANs down until an uplink is found)

fcc_handbuch.Ports: Ethernet Port und Reset Button (unter der Port Cover). Ethernet: Gigabit PoE port ... Power: Gigabit PoE adapter (included), UniFi Switch with PoE, 802.3af PoE compliant switch.
fcc_handbuch.Reset: Restart: Press and release quickly. Restore to Factory Default: Press and hold for more than five seconds until the Status LED turns off.
fcc_handbuch.Mounting: Wall Mount (Bracket, 2 Screws); Pole Mount (Zip Tie through slot of the mount bracket); Fast-Mount Adapter for Ubiquiti high-gain antenna with fast-mount radio mounting bracket
fcc_handbuch.Attach Antennas: Remove and discard the two black boot covers. Ensure the Rubber Gaskets remain in place. Connect the Antennas to the RP-SMA connectors.
fcc_handbuch.Powering: Slide the Port Cover down to remove it. Connect an Ethernet cable to the Ethernet port, and then replace the Port Cover. PoE adapter: POE port -> AP, LAN port -> LAN; PoE adapter has removable mounting bracket.

Specifications.Power Method: 24V Passive PoE (Pairs 4, 5+; 7, 8 Return); 802.3af Alternative A (Pairs 1, 2+; 3, 6 Return)

fcc_handbuch.Safety: WARNING: Do not use this product in location that can be submerged by water. Avoid using this product during an electrical storm.
fcc_handbuch.FCC Antenna Information: 2 Omnidirectional antennas, Gain: 3 dBi (2.4 GHz), 4 dBi (5 GHz)
